title: Interventional, multicenter, open-label, randomized, non-comparative trial evaluating the safety, in terms of HBV virological control, of 2 antiviral treatment relief strategies, in patients co-infected with the HIV-1 and HBV viruses
official: Interventional, multicenter, open-label, randomized, non-comparative trial evaluating the safety, in terms of HBV virological control, of 2 antiviral treatment relief strategies, in patients co-infected with the HIV-1 and HBV viruses
summary: Main objective: The main objective of this trial is to evaluate at 96 weeks the safety with respect to chronic viral hepatitis B control of 2 treatment reduction strategies for patients with previously controlled HIV-HBV co-infection on continuous triple therapy
conditions: co-infected with the HIV-1 and HBV viruses

interventions.name: Norvir 100 mg powder for oral suspension

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. HIV-1-HBV co-infection (positive HIV-1 serology associated with 2 positive HBsAg serologies within more than 6 months)
2. HIV CV < 50cp/ml for ≥ 2 years (only 1 annual blip allowed if HIV CV < 200cp/ml and previous and subsequent viral loads are undetectable)
3. HBV CV < 10 IU/ml for ≥ 2 years (only 1 annual blip allowed if HBV CV < 200IU/ml and if previous and subsequent viral loads are undetectable)
4. Have ≥ 3 available measurements of HIV CV < 50cp/ml and HBV CV < 10 IU/mL over the past 30 months (including that of pre-inclusion
5. CD4 lymphocytes > 250/mm3 at pre-inclusion
6. Positive Ag HBs HBV serology at pre-inclusion
7. ALT < 3N at pre-inclusion
8. For women of childbearing potential, negative pregnancy test and commitment to use effective contraception throughout the trial
9. Person affiliated with or benefiting from a social security system
10. Free, informed, written consent, signed by the person and the investigator at the latest on the day of inclusion and before any examination carried out as part of the study (article L1122-1-1 of the Public Health Code)
11. Age ≥ 18 years
12. Fibroscan less than 6 months < 9kPa
13. Current daily antiretroviral tritherapy  not modified for ≥ 12 months must including tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) 245mg or tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF -25mg) associated to lamivudine (3TC – 300mg) or emtricitabine (FTC - 200mg) and a NNRTI or PI/r or INSTI to choose from  o	NNRTI = efavirenz, rilpivirine, etravirine, doravirine o	PI/r = atazanavir/r ou darunavir/r o	INSTI = bictegravir, dolutegravir, elvitegravir/cobicistat, raltegravir
14. Absence of documented HBV and HIV genotypic resistance compromising virologic control of any of the maintenance strategies. Patients with no genotypic history may be included)
Exclusion criteria:
1. HIV-2 infection
2. Any condition (drug use, neurological, neuropsychiatric, etc.) that, in the judgment of the investigator, may compromise patient compliance and adherence to the protocol
3. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman or refusal of contraception
4. Major incapacity, legal protection, guardianship or curatorship.
5. HIV and/or HBV genotype not compatible with dual therapy DTG-3TC or DRVr-3TC
6. HBeAg+.
7. Fibrosis history at stage F3-F4 in pre-therapy evaluated by PBH, fibrotest and/or fibroscan with a value of Elastometry ≥ 9kPa
8. Chronic active viral hepatitis C (HCV RNA positive)
9. Delta co-infection
10. Alcohol consumption > 14 units/week for women and 21 units/week for men
11. Current treatment with chemo- or immunotherapy (including interferon or interleukins)
12. Active opportunistic infection or acute treatment for opportunistic infection
